what: a modelled 3/4-6 ACME thread (ASME B1.5, general purpose) on a 3/4 in shaft, six turns
method: groove volume per turn 2 pi int r w(r) dr over the material it cuts (Pappus on the axial section; a screw motion), w(r) = P - flat - depth (tan a + tan b); six whole turns between free ends, so V = stock - 6 x that. Tolerance 0.01%: SMLib's exact screw sweep. ASME B1.5: 29 deg, h = P/2, crest flat 0.3707 P, external minor d - P - 0.020 in (10 threads per inch or coarser)
